text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The southern town of Lobatse has been indentified as the most suitable site for an Export Oriented Trans-Shipping Industrial Estate.
- Namibia will go ahead with the construction of a 250 km pipeline which is part of a proposed plan to extract water from the Okavango river and to transfer it to the Namibian capital of Windhoek.
- A second reading of the Criminal Procedure and Evidence Amendment Bill, which seeks to allow cases of rape, indecent assault and the defilement of minors to be heard in camera, has been postponed.
